summary: Iter-7 regression + diagnostic-hardening verification for the 'New RFP 404' user report. Confirmed (1) New-RFP create flow still returns 200 and lands in list with no error banner, (2) edit-existing-RFP update flow still saves without error, (3) axios response interceptor in apiClient.js logs '[API <status>] <METHOD> <URL>' to console ONLY on 4xx/5xx (nothing logged on success), (4) enriched RFPForm handleSave error banner now renders '<status> · <METHOD> <url> · <detail>' — verified by intercepting POST /api/rfps to return a forced 422, banner showed exactly '422 · POST /rfps · Forced test error' and console showed '[API 422] POST https://app-from-specs-9.preview.emergentagent.com/api/rfps {detail: Forced test error}'. No regressions detected; success paths remain silent.
action_items: None blocking. Iter-7 diagnostic hardening (axios interceptor + enriched error text) works exactly as intended and does not affect the happy path. If the user re-reports a 404, they can now screenshot either the red banner or the browser console for a full request footprint.
critical_code_review_comments: apiClient.js interceptor uses console.error which will appear in Sentry/log aggregators as an error even for expected 4xx like validation failures — consider console.warn for 4xx and console.error only for 5xx if noise becomes an issue.

RFPForm.jsx handleSave: e.config.url is the axios relative path ('/rfps'), not the full URL. For clearer forensics, prefer `${e.config.baseURL || ''}${e.config.url}` to match the interceptor's format.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (regression flows pass; forced error surfaces correctly)

seed_data_creation: Created & deleted TEST_ITER7_REG / TEST_ITER7_FAIL RFPs during test; DB left clean (verified via DELETE 200).
